train_unconditional_ddpm: train an unconditional DDPM model on images using UNet2DModel with configurable dataset and scheduler
run_ddpm_training_script: run the unconditional image generation training script with dataset, resolution, and optimizer arguments
configure_ddpm_scheduler: configure a DDPMScheduler with custom timesteps, beta schedule, and prediction type for diffusion training
setup_ema_model_weights: setup an Exponential Moving Average model to smooth UNet weights during diffusion model training
generate_sample_images: generate sample images from a trained DDPM pipeline for visual inspection and logging
